statements.text: In File No. USD01-WRKS0/30/2026-WORKS, the Commissioner of Urban Services proposed to accord administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for the emergency restoration of a storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation.
statements.quote: The Commissioner, Urban Services, has submitted (Flag A) that a storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation was breached in the heavy rains of 18-09-2026, and has proposed to accord administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for emergency restoration.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.27, administrative sanction for works, including emergency works, costing above Rs.1.00 crore can only be accorded by the Government.
statements.quote: (vi) Works (including emergency works) costing above Rs.1.00 crore – Government only.
